validatorOwnedLaws.$comment: Machine-locatable registry of semantic graph and canonicalization laws that JSON Schema cannot prove. The canonical ownership-input validator MUST enforce every required entry; serialized claims are never trusted as evidence.

entry_and_query_state_references.const: state_graph.entry_state_id resolves exactly one OwnershipState whose point_id equals cfg.entry_point_id; non-Join query_state_id_or_null resolves exactly one state at cfg.current_point_id; Join query_state_id_or_null is null.

decision_point_binding.const: escape_context.decision_point_id equals cfg.current_point_id and equals operation.at_point_id, ReplaceInout.acquire_point_id, or Join.target_point_id according to the selected operation.

escape_boundary_target_origin_binding.const: escape_context.target_region_origin_or_null is null exactly for NotApplicable or boundary None. BeginSharedLoan and BeginExclusiveLoan are resolved before the ordinary existing-view path: source is independently derived through operation.loan_id to the exact LoanDef.owner_place_id and ultimate non-view PlaceDef.storage_region_id; Return, Capture and Suspension require LoanRegion bound to operation.loan_id, target equals the exact LoanDef.region_id, operation.region_id equals LoanDef.region_id, the view PlaceDef.storage_region_id equals LoanDef.region_id, and operation start/owner/view/kind fields exactly match the LoanDef. These Begin contexts are valid before separate BorrowEscape boundary-policy admission; every other Begin boundary is INPUT_INVALID. For an ordinary existing-view operation explicitly excluding BeginSharedLoan, BeginExclusiveLoan, Move and Join, Return requires RegionAncestor whose source equals the independently recomputed active via-loan source and whose nearest ancestor of required kind Invocation is the target; Capture or Suspension requires exactly one current-point active LoanRegion. Actual-boundary Move requires PlaceStorage bound to operation.destination_place_id and Store is not admitted in R5. Every other operation-boundary-origin combination is INPUT_INVALID. The validator resolves expected source, origin and target without reading their serialized values as an oracle, and target_region_id_or_null equals the resolved RegionId exactly.

operation_prefix_reachability_and_biject.const: state_graph.operation_prefix_point_ids is exactly the canonical-sorted intersection of points reachable from cfg.entry_point_id and points that can reach cfg.current_point_id; it includes the current point for non-Join, excludes the not-yet-produced Join target, and is in bijection with OwnershipState.point_id.

identity_uniqueness_and_reference_closur.const: Every declared identity is unique in its identity domain and every typed reference resolves exactly once to the required domain; retired OwnerId, consumed CleanupTokenId, ReservationId, and JoinConflictId values remain unavailable for reuse throughout the operation prefix.

graph_acyclicity.const: PlaceGraph move-path parent/child links, LoanRegionGraph region-parent and loan-parent links, and normalized ViewAliasBinding ownership/view links are referentially closed and acyclic.

cfg_state_coupling.const: cfg.predecessor_state_ids is exactly the canonical state image of reachable incoming CFG edge sources for cfg.current_point_id; current-point AccessFact rows are the exact operation-role bijection and their sequence_ordinal values are the canonical role order.

join_conflict_coverage.const: A Join mismatch produces at most one exact JoinConflict row; predecessor IDs and mismatch axes are complete, covered_places contains every declared place overlapping a mismatching place after ViewAlias normalization, and each covered place contains one exact predecessor tuple for every predecessor state.
